text.label: The text
text.note: Every chapter: the original languages with every word parsed, four English translations, the places, the people, the events, the translators’ notes and the cross-references.

study.label: Word study
study.note: The lexicons, the concordance, the Bible dictionary, the gazetteer and the chronologies — everything behind tapping a word or a marker.

search.label: Search
search.note: The indexes that let you search the text, the glosses and the notes with no connection.

pictures.label: Photographs of the places
pictures.note: A photograph of each biblical site that has one — 307 of the 1,342 places. The rest have no picture, and say so.

engravings.label: Doré’s engravings
engravings.note: 150 plates engraved for the Bible in 1866, set in the text at the verse each one illustrates.

commentary.label: The commentators
commentary.note: Henry, the Geneva notes, Calvin, Poole, Trapp and Spurgeon on almost every verse. The biggest piece by far — skip it if you are short of room.
